caseName: Aetna Life & Casualty Co. v. Young
caseNameFull: Aetna Life & Casualty Co. v. Young

opinions.text:
Appeal from Super. Ct. Conn., Fairfield County, dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
